<thought>To obtain the precursors, I need a retrosynthetic template that describes an SN2 substitution where a halide leaving group is replaced by a nucleophile. I will search the template catalog for templates that break a halide functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
